snippet.title: Tough Call | D.Mon Hero Trailer | Overwatch
snippet.description:
Every hero needs a squad, and every squad needs a leader.

Watch as D.Mon and the MEKA Squad go up against Wrecking Ball and the Junkers in our newest Hero Trailer, Tough Call.

And join her on the battlefield as our next Tank Hero when Season 4 starts Aug 11.

Animation created in partnership with Red Dog Culture House

Overwatch is free to play on PC and console, now including Nintendo Switch™ 2"!
